en.g: Sound careful and balanced with hedging words like it seems that and arguably.
p: Hedging softens a claim: It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to and to some extent: People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.
Modals hedge too: This may be true. It could be a problem. Compare: It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
en.q: What is something you believe is true, but only to some extent? Explain with tends to or arguably.
en.c: Rewrite three strong opinions with hedging: it seems that, arguably and to some extent.

de.g: Du klingst vorsichtig und ausgewogen mit Formulierungen wie it seems that und arguably.
p: Hedging schwächt eine Aussage ab: It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to und to some extent: People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.
Auch Modalverben helfen: This may be true. It could be a problem. Vergleiche: It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
de.q: Was hältst du nur bis zu einem gewissen Grad für wahr? Erkläre es mit tends to oder arguably.
de.c: Formuliere drei starke Meinungen vorsichtiger: mit it seems that, arguably und to some extent.

es.g: Suena prudente y equilibrado con expresiones como it seems that y arguably.
p: El hedging suaviza una afirmación: It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to y to some extent: People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.
Los modales también suavizan: This may be true. It could be a problem. Compara: It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
es.q: ¿Qué crees que es cierto, pero solo hasta cierto punto? Explícalo con tends to o arguably.
es.c: Reescribe tres opiniones tajantes con it seems that, arguably y to some extent.

fr.g: Exprime-toi avec nuance et prudence grâce à it seems that et arguably.
p: Le hedging atténue une affirmation : It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to et to some extent : People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.
Les modaux nuancent aussi : This may be true. It could be a problem. Compare : It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
fr.q: Qu'est-ce que tu crois vrai, mais seulement dans une certaine mesure ? Explique avec tends to ou arguably.
fr.c: Réécris trois opinions tranchées avec it seems that, arguably et to some extent.

it.g: Esprimiti in modo cauto ed equilibrato con formule come it seems that e arguably.
p: L'hedging attenua un'affermazione: It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to e to some extent: People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.
Anche i modali attenuano: This may be true. It could be a problem. Confronta: It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
it.q: Cosa pensi sia vero, ma solo fino a un certo punto? Spiegalo con tends to o arguably.
it.c: Riscrivi tre opinioni nette usando it seems that, arguably e to some extent.

pt.g: Soa prudente e equilibrado com expressões como it seems that e arguably.

Os modais também suavizam: This may be true. It could be a problem. Compara: It is wrong vs It might not be ideal.
pt.q: Em que acreditas, mas só até certo ponto? Explica com tends to ou arguably.
pt.c: Reescreve três opiniões fortes com it seems that, arguably e to some extent.

pt_BR.g: Soe cuidadoso e equilibrado com expressões como it seems that e arguably.
p: O hedging suaviza uma afirmação: It seems that... It appears that... This is arguably the best option.
Tends to e to some extent: People tend to work longer hours. I agree to some extent.

pt_BR.c: Reescreva três opiniões fortes com it seems that, arguably e to some extent.

vocab.ex: It seems that the meeting has been moved.

target.gram: Hedging: it seems/appears that, arguably, tend to, to some extent and modals (may, might, could) make claims less absolute.

en.g: Shift register by choosing formal or neutral words: request or ask, obtain or get.
p: Formal verbs are often longer: request (ask), obtain (get), assist (help), require (need), inform (tell).
Formal English avoids phrasal verbs and contractions: We regret to inform you... vs Sorry to tell you...
Neutral English fits most emails to colleagues; formal fits official letters, applications and reports.
en.q: Which situations in your life need formal English, and which are fine with neutral English?
en.c: Turn this into formal English: Can you help me get the forms? I need them by Friday.

de.g: Du wechselst das Register mit formellen oder neutralen Wörtern: request oder ask, obtain oder get.

Formelles Englisch meidet Phrasal Verbs und Kurzformen: We regret to inform you... statt Sorry to tell you...
Neutral passt für die meisten Mails an Kollegen, formell für offizielle Briefe, Bewerbungen und Berichte.
de.q: In welchen Situationen brauchst du formelles Englisch, und wo reicht neutrales?
de.c: Mach diesen Satz formell: Can you help me get the forms? I need them by Friday.

es.g: Cambia de registro eligiendo palabras formales o neutras: request o ask, obtain o get.

El inglés formal evita phrasal verbs y contracciones: We regret to inform you... frente a Sorry to tell you...
El neutro sirve para casi todos los correos a colegas; el formal, para cartas oficiales, solicitudes e informes.
es.q: ¿En qué situaciones de tu vida necesitas inglés formal y en cuáles basta el neutro?
es.c: Pasa esto a inglés formal: Can you help me get the forms? I need them by Friday.

Le neutre convient à la plupart des mails entre collègues ; le formel aux lettres officielles, candidatures et rapports.
fr.q: Dans quelles situations as-tu besoin d'un anglais formel, et quand le neutre suffit-il ?
fr.c: Rends cette phrase formelle : Can you help me get the forms? I need them by Friday.

target.gram: Formal register: Latin-based verbs (request, obtain, assist), no contractions, fewer phrasal verbs; neutral register suits everyday work.

en.g: Write a formal letter or enquiry with the right structure, tone and fixed phrases.
p: Open: Dear Sir or Madam (name unknown) or Dear Ms Lee. Reason: I am writing to enquire about...
Body: one idea per paragraph. Polite requests: I would be grateful if you could... Could you please confirm...?
Close: I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully (no name) or Yours sincerely (with name).
en.q: Have you ever had to write a formal letter or email? What was it about and how did it go?
en.c: Write a short formal enquiry to a language school asking about course dates and prices.

de.g: Du schreibst einen formellen Brief oder eine Anfrage mit passender Struktur, Ton und festen Wendungen.
p: Anrede: Dear Sir or Madam (Name unbekannt) oder Dear Ms Lee. Anlass: I am writing to enquire about...
Hauptteil: ein Gedanke pro Absatz. Höfliche Bitten: I would be grateful if you could... Could you please confirm...?
Schluss: I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully (ohne Namen) oder Yours sincerely (mit Namen).
de.q: Musstest du schon einmal einen formellen Brief schreiben? Worum ging es, und wie lief es?
de.c: Schreib eine kurze formelle Anfrage an eine Sprachschule zu Kursterminen und Preisen.

es.g: Escribe una carta o consulta formal con la estructura, el tono y las fórmulas adecuadas.
p: Saludo: Dear Sir or Madam (sin nombre) o Dear Ms Lee. Motivo: I am writing to enquire about...
Cuerpo: una idea por párrafo. Peticiones corteses: I would be grateful if you could... Could you please confirm...?
Cierre: I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully (sin nombre) o Yours sincerely (con nombre).
es.q: ¿Alguna vez has tenido que escribir una carta formal? ¿Sobre qué era y cómo salió?
es.c: Escribe una breve consulta formal a una academia de idiomas sobre fechas y precios de cursos.

Corps : une idée par paragraphe. Demandes polies : I would be grateful if you could... Could you please confirm...?
Clôture : I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully (sans nom) ou Yours sincerely (avec nom).
fr.q: As-tu déjà dû écrire une lettre formelle ? De quoi s'agissait-il et comment ça s'est passé ?
fr.c: Écris une courte demande formelle à une école de langues sur les dates et les prix des cours.

Chiusura: I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully (senza nome) o Yours sincerely (con nome).

pt.c: Escreve um pequeno pedido formal a uma escola de línguas sobre datas e preços dos cursos.

en.g: Write a clear report with headings, a purpose, findings and recommendations.
p: Structure: Introduction (The aim of this report is to...), Findings, Conclusion and Recommendations.
Use headings and neutral language: The survey shows that... A majority of staff stated that...
Recommend politely: It is recommended that... I would suggest introducing... It would be advisable to...
en.q: If you wrote a report about your town, school or office, what would you recommend improving?
en.c: Write a mini report (four headings, one sentence each) about a café or gym you know.

en.g: Find the main ideas of a text and express them briefly in your own words.
p: First read for gist, then underline the key idea of each paragraph. Ignore examples and small details.
Start with the source: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Keep it short and neutral: no new opinions. Link ideas with while, whereas, as a result, overall.
en.q: What is the last article, video or book you enjoyed? Summarise it in two sentences.
en.c: Choose a short news story and summarise it in exactly 40 words.

de.g: Du erkennst die Hauptgedanken eines Textes und gibst sie kurz in eigenen Worten wieder.
p: Lies zuerst für den Gesamteindruck, dann markiere die Kernaussage jedes Absatzes. Beispiele und Details weglassen.
Beginne mit der Quelle: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Kurz und neutral bleiben: keine eigene Meinung. Verbinde Ideen mit while, whereas, as a result, overall.
de.q: Welcher Artikel, welches Video oder Buch hat dir zuletzt gefallen? Fasse es in zwei Sätzen zusammen.
de.c: Wähle eine kurze Nachricht und fasse sie in genau 40 Wörtern zusammen.

es.g: Encuentra las ideas principales de un texto y exprésalas brevemente con tus palabras.
p: Primero lee para captar la idea general; luego subraya la idea clave de cada párrafo. Omite ejemplos y detalles.
Empieza por la fuente: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Sé breve y neutral: sin opiniones nuevas. Une ideas con while, whereas, as a result, overall.
es.q: ¿Cuál es el último artículo, vídeo o libro que te gustó? Resúmelo en dos frases.
es.c: Elige una noticia corta y resúmela en exactamente 40 palabras.

fr.g: Repère les idées principales d'un texte et exprime-les brièvement avec tes propres mots.
p: Lis d'abord pour l'idée générale, puis souligne l'idée clé de chaque paragraphe. Laisse les exemples et détails.
Commence par la source : The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Reste bref et neutre : pas d'opinion nouvelle. Relie les idées avec while, whereas, as a result, overall.
fr.q: Quel est le dernier article, vidéo ou livre qui t'a plu ? Résume-le en deux phrases.
fr.c: Choisis une brève info et résume-la en exactement 40 mots.

it.g: Individua le idee principali di un testo ed esprimile in breve con parole tue.
p: Prima leggi per il senso generale, poi sottolinea l'idea chiave di ogni paragrafo. Tralascia esempi e dettagli.
Parti dalla fonte: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Sii breve e neutrale: niente opinioni nuove. Collega le idee con while, whereas, as a result, overall.
it.q: Qual è l'ultimo articolo, video o libro che ti è piaciuto? Riassumilo in due frasi.
it.c: Scegli una breve notizia e riassumila in esattamente 40 parole.

pt.g: Encontra as ideias principais de um texto e exprime-as brevemente por palavras tuas.
p: Lê primeiro para a ideia geral, depois sublinha a ideia-chave de cada parágrafo. Ignora exemplos e pormenores.
Começa pela fonte: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Sê breve e neutro: sem opiniões novas. Liga ideias com while, whereas, as a result, overall.

pt.c: Escolhe uma notícia curta e resume-a em exatamente 40 palavras.

pt_BR.g: Encontre as ideias principais de um texto e expresse-as brevemente com suas palavras.
p: Leia primeiro para pegar a ideia geral, depois sublinhe a ideia-chave de cada parágrafo. Ignore exemplos e detalhes.
Comece pela fonte: The article argues that... The author claims... According to the text...
Seja breve e neutro: sem opiniões novas. Ligue ideias com while, whereas, as a result, overall.

vocab.ex: The article argues that cities need more parks.
The main idea is that sleep improves memory.
According to the author, reading daily helps.
In short, the plan saves time and money.
Some prefer trains, whereas others prefer flying.
Overall, the text is positive about remote work.

target.gram: Summaries: reporting verbs (argue, claim, suggest) + that; present simple; own words; no personal opinion or minor details.

en.g: Paraphrase by changing words and structure while keeping the meaning.
p: Use synonyms: important becomes essential, rise becomes increase, start becomes begin.
Change the structure: active to passive, verb to noun. People use the app widely becomes The app is widely used.
Keep the meaning and key terms. Useful openers: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
en.q: Can you explain your job or studies in two different ways, as if to a child and to an expert?
en.c: Paraphrase this sentence twice: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

de.g: Du paraphrasierst, indem du Wörter und Satzbau änderst, die Bedeutung aber behältst.
p: Synonyme nutzen: important wird essential, rise wird increase, start wird begin.
Satzbau ändern: Aktiv zu Passiv, Verb zu Nomen. People use the app widely wird The app is widely used.
Bedeutung und Fachbegriffe bleiben. Nützliche Einstiege: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
de.q: Kannst du deinen Job oder dein Studium auf zwei Arten erklären, einem Kind und einem Experten?
de.c: Formuliere diesen Satz zweimal um: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

es.g: Parafrasea cambiando palabras y estructura sin cambiar el significado.
p: Usa sinónimos: important pasa a essential, rise a increase, start a begin.
Cambia la estructura: activa a pasiva, verbo a sustantivo. People use the app widely pasa a The app is widely used.
Mantén el sentido y los términos clave. Fórmulas útiles: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
es.q: ¿Puedes explicar tu trabajo o tus estudios de dos maneras, a un niño y a un experto?
es.c: Parafrasea esta frase dos veces: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

fr.g: Reformule en changeant les mots et la structure tout en gardant le sens.
p: Utilise des synonymes : important devient essential, rise devient increase, start devient begin.
Change la structure : actif en passif, verbe en nom. People use the app widely devient The app is widely used.
Garde le sens et les termes clés. Amorces utiles : In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
fr.q: Peux-tu expliquer ton travail ou tes études de deux façons, à un enfant et à un expert ?
fr.c: Reformule cette phrase deux fois : Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

it.g: Parafrasa cambiando parole e struttura senza cambiare il significato.
p: Usa sinonimi: important diventa essential, rise diventa increase, start diventa begin.
Cambia la struttura: da attiva a passiva, da verbo a nome. People use the app widely diventa The app is widely used.
Mantieni senso e termini chiave. Formule utili: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
it.q: Sai spiegare il tuo lavoro o i tuoi studi in due modi, a un bambino e a un esperto?
it.c: Parafrasa questa frase due volte: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

pt.g: Parafraseia mudando palavras e estrutura sem mudar o sentido.
p: Usa sinónimos: important passa a essential, rise a increase, start a begin.
Muda a estrutura: ativa para passiva, verbo para nome. People use the app widely passa a The app is widely used.
Mantém o sentido e os termos-chave. Fórmulas úteis: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
pt.q: Consegues explicar o teu trabalho ou estudos de duas formas, a uma criança e a um especialista?
pt.c: Parafraseia esta frase duas vezes: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

pt_BR.g: Parafraseie mudando palavras e estrutura sem mudar o sentido.
p: Use sinônimos: important vira essential, rise vira increase, start vira begin.
Mude a estrutura: ativa para passiva, verbo para substantivo. People use the app widely vira The app is widely used.
Mantenha o sentido e os termos-chave. Fórmulas úteis: In other words... What I mean is... To put it another way...
pt_BR.q: Você consegue explicar seu trabalho ou estudo de duas formas, para uma criança e para um especialista?
pt_BR.c: Parafraseie esta frase duas vezes: Learning a language takes time, but it opens many doors.

vocab.ex: In other words, we need more time.
To put it another way, practice beats talent.
What I mean is that the price is too high.
Water is essential for all living things.
There has been an increase in cyclists.
English is widely used in science.

target.gram: Paraphrasing: change words (synonyms), word class (verb to noun) and structure (active to passive) while keeping the original meaning.

en.g: Build a convincing argument with a claim, a reason, an example and a conclusion.
p: Claim: I firmly believe that... Reason: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Example: For instance... A good example of this is... Evidence makes your reason believable.
Conclusion: Therefore... That is why... Then answer the other side: Some may say..., however...
en.q: Do you think everyone should learn a second language? Give a claim, a reason and an example.
en.c: Write a five-sentence argument for or against a four-day working week.

de.g: Du baust ein überzeugendes Argument auf: Behauptung, Begründung, Beispiel, Schluss.
p: Behauptung: I firmly believe that... Begründung: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Beispiel: For instance... A good example of this is... Belege machen deine Begründung glaubwürdig.
Schluss: Therefore... That is why... Dann die Gegenseite: Some may say..., however...
de.q: Sollte jeder eine zweite Sprache lernen? Nenne Behauptung, Begründung und Beispiel.
de.c: Schreib ein Argument in fünf Sätzen für oder gegen die Vier-Tage-Woche.

es.g: Construye un argumento convincente con tesis, razón, ejemplo y conclusión.
p: Tesis: I firmly believe that... Razón: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Ejemplo: For instance... A good example of this is... Las pruebas hacen creíble tu razón.
Conclusión: Therefore... That is why... Luego responde a la otra parte: Some may say..., however...
es.q: ¿Crees que todo el mundo debería aprender un segundo idioma? Da tesis, razón y ejemplo.
es.c: Escribe un argumento de cinco frases a favor o en contra de la semana laboral de cuatro días.

fr.g: Construis un argument convaincant : thèse, raison, exemple, conclusion.
p: Thèse : I firmly believe that... Raison : This is because... / The main reason is that...
Exemple : For instance... A good example of this is... Les preuves rendent ta raison crédible.
Conclusion : Therefore... That is why... Puis réponds à l'autre camp : Some may say..., however...
fr.q: Penses-tu que tout le monde devrait apprendre une deuxième langue ? Donne thèse, raison et exemple.
fr.c: Écris un argument en cinq phrases pour ou contre la semaine de quatre jours.

it.g: Costruisci un'argomentazione convincente: tesi, motivo, esempio, conclusione.
p: Tesi: I firmly believe that... Motivo: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Esempio: For instance... A good example of this is... Le prove rendono credibile il motivo.
Conclusione: Therefore... That is why... Poi rispondi all'altra parte: Some may say..., however...
it.q: Pensi che tutti dovrebbero imparare una seconda lingua? Dai tesi, motivo ed esempio.
it.c: Scrivi un'argomentazione di cinque frasi a favore o contro la settimana lavorativa di quattro giorni.

pt.g: Constrói um argumento convincente com tese, razão, exemplo e conclusão.
p: Tese: I firmly believe that... Razão: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Exemplo: For instance... A good example of this is... As provas tornam a razão credível.
Conclusão: Therefore... That is why... Depois responde ao outro lado: Some may say..., however...
pt.q: Achas que toda a gente devia aprender uma segunda língua? Dá tese, razão e exemplo.
pt.c: Escreve um argumento de cinco frases a favor ou contra a semana de trabalho de quatro dias.

pt_BR.g: Construa um argumento convincente com tese, motivo, exemplo e conclusão.
p: Tese: I firmly believe that... Motivo: This is because... / The main reason is that...
Exemplo: For instance... A good example of this is... As evidências deixam o motivo convincente.
Conclusão: Therefore... That is why... Depois responda ao outro lado: Some may say..., however...
pt_BR.q: Você acha que todo mundo deveria aprender uma segunda língua? Dê tese, motivo e exemplo.
pt_BR.c: Escreva um argumento de cinco frases a favor ou contra a semana de trabalho de quatro dias.

vocab.ex: I firmly believe that reading builds vocabulary.
The main reason is that it saves time.
Many cities, for instance Copenhagen, love bikes.
A good example of this is online banking.
It is cheap and fast. Therefore, I recommend it.
Some may say it is expensive; however, it lasts.

target.gram: Argument structure: claim (I firmly believe that), reason (because), example (for instance), counter-argument (some may say), conclusion.

en.g: Debate with grace using phrases like I take your point, but... and With respect, I'd argue that...
p: Acknowledge first: I take your point, but... That's a fair point; however... I see where you're coming from.
Disagree softly: With respect, I'd argue that... I'm not sure I agree. Couldn't it also be said that...?
Keep it friendly: Can I just add something? Sorry, may I finish? Let's agree to disagree.
en.q: Is it better to travel alone or with friends? Disagree politely with the opposite view.
en.c: Practise three polite disagreements aloud, each starting with a different phrase from today.

de.g: Du debattierst respektvoll mit Wendungen wie I take your point, but... und With respect, I'd argue that...
p: Erst anerkennen: I take your point, but... That's a fair point; however... I see where you're coming from.
Sanft widersprechen: With respect, I'd argue that... I'm not sure I agree. Couldn't it also be said that...?
Freundlich bleiben: Can I just add something? Sorry, may I finish? Let's agree to disagree.
de.q: Reist man besser allein oder mit Freunden? Widersprich höflich der Gegenmeinung.
de.c: Übe laut drei höfliche Widersprüche, jeder mit einer anderen Wendung von heute.

Discrepa con suavidad: With respect, I'd argue that... I'm not sure I agree. Couldn't it also be said that...?
Mantén el buen tono: Can I just add something? Sorry, may I finish? Let's agree to disagree.
es.q: ¿Es mejor viajar solo o con amigos? Discrepa con cortesía de la opinión contraria.
es.c: Practica en voz alta tres desacuerdos corteses, cada uno con una frase distinta de hoy.

fr.g: Débats avec élégance grâce à I take your point, but... et With respect, I'd argue that...

fr.q: Vaut-il mieux voyager seul ou entre amis ? Contredis poliment l'avis opposé.
fr.c: Entraîne-toi à voix haute à trois désaccords polis, chacun avec une formule différente du jour.

pt.g: Debate com elegância usando frases como I take your point, but... e With respect, I'd argue that...

target.gram: Polite debate: acknowledge (I take your point), then contrast (but/however), soften with I'd argue, I'm not sure, couldn't it be said.

en.g: Persuade an audience with rhetorical questions, the rule of three and strong verbs.
p: Rhetorical questions make people think: Who doesn't want more free time? Isn't it time we acted?
The rule of three is memorable: It's quick, cheap and easy. Strong verbs: transform, boost, discover.
Speak to the listener: Imagine... You deserve... Just think how... Add a clear call to action: Join us today!
en.q: What product, place or habit would you love to persuade people to try? Why?
en.c: Write a three-sentence advert for your favourite place using a rhetorical question and the rule of three.

de.g: Du überzeugst ein Publikum mit rhetorischen Fragen, der Dreierregel und starken Verben.
p: Rhetorische Fragen regen an: Who doesn't want more free time? Isn't it time we acted?
Die Dreierregel bleibt hängen: It's quick, cheap and easy. Starke Verben: transform, boost, discover.
Sprich die Zuhörer an: Imagine... You deserve... Just think how... Plus klarer Aufruf: Join us today!
de.q: Welches Produkt, welchen Ort oder welche Gewohnheit würdest du anderen gern schmackhaft machen? Warum?
de.c: Schreib eine Werbung in drei Sätzen für deinen Lieblingsort mit rhetorischer Frage und Dreierregel.

es.g: Persuade a tu público con preguntas retóricas, la regla de tres y verbos potentes.

La regla de tres se recuerda: It's quick, cheap and easy. Verbos potentes: transform, boost, discover.
Habla al oyente: Imagine... You deserve... Just think how... Y una llamada clara a la acción: Join us today!
es.q: ¿Qué producto, lugar o hábito te encantaría convencer a la gente de probar? ¿Por qué?
es.c: Escribe un anuncio de tres frases sobre tu lugar favorito con una pregunta retórica y la regla de tres.

fr.c: Écris une pub de trois phrases pour ton lieu préféré avec une question rhétorique et la règle de trois.

en.g: Recap register, reports, summaries and debate skills in a mini debate.
p: Register: formal (request, obtain, I would be grateful if) vs neutral (ask, get, could you). Hedge with arguably.
Texts: letters (Yours faithfully), reports (It is recommended that), summaries (The article argues that).
Arguing: claim, reason, example. Debate: I take your point, but... Persuade: Isn't it time we...?
en.q: Should schools teach money skills? Give your view, hedge one point and answer an objection politely.
en.c: Hold a two-minute mini debate with yourself: argue one side, then politely answer it from the other.

de.g: Du wiederholst Register, Berichte, Zusammenfassungen und Debattieren in einer Mini-Debatte.
p: Register: formell (request, obtain, I would be grateful if) vs neutral (ask, get, could you). Abschwächen mit arguably.
Texte: Briefe (Yours faithfully), Berichte (It is recommended that), Zusammenfassungen (The article argues that).
Argumentieren: Behauptung, Grund, Beispiel. Debatte: I take your point, but... Überzeugen: Isn't it time we...?
de.q: Sollten Schulen Finanzwissen lehren? Sag deine Meinung, schwäche einen Punkt ab und kontere höflich einen Einwand.
de.c: Führe eine Zwei-Minuten-Debatte mit dir selbst: vertritt eine Seite und antworte dann höflich als Gegenseite.

es.g: Repasa registro, informes, resúmenes y debate en un minidebate.

Textos: cartas (Yours faithfully), informes (It is recommended that), resúmenes (The article argues that).
Argumentar: tesis, razón, ejemplo. Debatir: I take your point, but... Persuadir: Isn't it time we...?
es.q: ¿Deberían los colegios enseñar a manejar el dinero? Da tu opinión, matiza un punto y responde con cortesía a una objeción.
es.c: Haz un minidebate de dos minutos contigo mismo: defiende una postura y luego respóndete desde la otra.
